summary.goal: Remove ~40 unused exported functions from the relay module to reduce maintenance burden and improve code clarity
summary.context: Audit identified exported functions that are never called. These exports create false API surface, make refactoring harder, and add confusion about what's actually in use.

acceptance_criteria.description: All identified dead code functions are removed from source files
All related exports are removed from index.ts
TypeScript compilation succeeds with no errors
No runtime errors when starting the server

observations: Dead code falls into 4 categories: agent spawning helpers, channel utilities, planner-lead helpers, ws-proxy utilities
Many functions were created for future features that never materialized
Some functions are legacy from spawn-based agent pattern (now using RelayClient)
The question queue functions (emitQuestion, askQuestion, answerQuestion) may have been intended for trajectory integration but aren't wired up
Index.ts re-exports all functions, making the public API bloated
questions: Should we keep any functions for future use with a KEEP_FOR_FUTURE marker?
Are any of these functions used in tests that should also be updated?
concerns: Some functions may be used in ideation package - need to verify before removing
spawnAgent/releaseAgent are used by ideation specialists - NOT dead code there

architect.cleanup_strategy: Remove from source, update exports, verify tests
architect.verification_method: TypeScript compilation + test suite + manual server start

steps.title: Analyze usage across packages
steps.description: Verify each function's usage across all packages (server, planner, planner-ui, ideation) to confirm true dead code vs cross-package dependencies

acceptance_criteria.description: Each function categorized as: REMOVE (unused everywhere), KEEP (used in other package), or DEFER (unclear)

steps.title: Remove ws-proxy dead code
steps.description: Remove getActiveConnections() and broadcastToUsers() from ws-proxy.ts if confirmed unused

dead_code.rationale: Monitoring/admin utilities never wired to any endpoint

steps.title: Remove channels.ts dead code
steps.description: Remove unused channel utility functions: removePlanChannel, getAllChannels, getChannelsForUser, channelExists

dead_code.rationale: Channel listing/query functions never exposed via API

steps.title: Remove planner-lead question helpers
steps.description: Remove question queue functions that are defined but not wired: emitQuestion, askQuestion, answerQuestion, emitPendingQuestion, clearPendingQuestion. Also remove related types and pending questions map if unused.

acceptance_criteria.description: QuestionPriority type removed if unused elsewhere

dead_code.rationale: Question queue integration was planned but implemented differently via MCP tools. Check if QuestionPriority type is used elsewhere before removing.

steps.title: Remove planner-lead legacy helpers
steps.description: Remove legacy/deprecated exports: isPlannerLeadActive, getPlannerLeadAgentId, joinPlannerLeadToChannel (already marked as no-op)

dead_code.rationale: Already marked as deprecated or no-op in comments

steps.title: Verify client.ts spawn functions usage
steps.description: Verify spawnAgent, releaseAgent, getSpawnedAgents, isAgentSpawned usage. These ARE used by ideation package - do NOT remove from client.ts, but may be able to remove from planner-core's index.ts if only ideation uses them directly.

acceptance_criteria.description: Document which spawn functions are used by ideation
Determine if exports should remain in index.ts or only in ideation's imports

analysis.rationale: Used by ideation package specialists - verify import paths before any changes

steps.title: Update index.ts exports
steps.description: Remove all dead exports from packages/server/src/relay/index.ts after individual files are cleaned

acceptance_criteria.description: index.ts only exports functions that are actually used

steps.title: Run tests and verify
steps.description: Run full test suite, type check, and manual server startup to verify nothing broke

cases.description: Ideation package still works with specialists
Removed exports cause compile error if still referenced (expected fail during dev)
